⚠️ Game is still in BETA, you may find bugs!
🔔 Turn on notifications and be the first to experience the game in its full glory when the big upgrade drops!

🏁 Welcome to Trailer Pursuit! [ 👑King of the Trailer! ]

Chase the truck, drive onto its moving trailer, and hold your spot for 10 seconds to win! Stay sharp—other racers will try to knock you off before the countdown ends!

🚗 Earn Cash to buy and equip new cars.
💨 Draft behind rivals and boost your way to the trailer.
💥 Bump opponents and battle for the winning spot.

👍Like & Favorites ⭐

♥️ Thanks for playing!
